articles.title: 54th QM Co. Soldiers deploy to CENTCOM AOR
articles.summary: More than 25 Soldiers assigned to Detachment 1, 54th Quartermaster Company (Fatality Management), 10th Transportation Battalion (Terminal), 7th Transportation Brigade (Expeditionary) were recognized in a deployment ceremony Nov. 2 at the Fort Lee Family Life Center as they prepare to deploy to the U.S.

articles.title: 121st Field Hospital Revives Korean War-Era Rail Evacuation With a Commercial Railcar
articles.summary: During exercise Pacific Medic Forge 26-2 in August 2026, Soldiers of the 121st Field Hospital converted a commercial Korean passenger railcar into a casualty evacuation platform, revisiting a practice the U.S. Army used in Korea in 1950.

articles.title: Tropic Lightning, Partner Forces Transition to the Close Battle at JPMRC 27-01
articles.summary: SCHOFIELD BARRACKS, Hawaii – After days of disciplined preparation and staging across the Hawaiian archipelago, U.S. Army forces and their multinational partners have officially transitioned into active, force-on-force maneuver training during Joint Pacific Multinational Readiness Center Rotation 27-01.

articles.title: Oregon National Guard trains with Multnomah County Sheriff's Office SAR MEDEVAC
articles.summary: The Oregon National Guard worked with the Multnomah County Sheriff's Office SAR MEDEVAC team members to conduct medical and first aid training on Nov. 1, 2026.

articles.title: Amid Iran conflict, ‘non-hostile’ deaths of 2 US airmen raise overseas toll
articles.summary: Two U.S. airmen supporting operations against Iran died last week in "non-hostile" incidents, raising the death toll to 23 since the war began.

articles.title: Fantastic Five: Introducing the TACOM Hall of Fame Class of 2026
articles.summary: Five careers. Decades of impact. One enduring legacy. Meet the former Army Civilians whose achievements, leadership and commitment to excellence earned them a spot in the U.S. Army Tank-automotive and Armaments Command Hall of Fame.

articles.title: Michelle Link named TACOM ILSC executive director
articles.summary: Michelle A. Link took the helm last month of the U.S. Army Tank-automotive and Armaments Command’s Integrated Logistics Support Center, leveraging decades of logistics and acquisition experience to forge future readiness.

articles.title: TACOM welcomes newest Hall of Fame inductees
articles.summary: Smiles, hugs and happy tears filled the Detroit Arsenal as five people who spent decades shaping the U.S. Army Tank-automotive and Armaments Command took a permanent place in its history. Agnes E. Holley-Smith, David W. Horton, Michele M. Moore, James “Patton” Tidwell and David L. Van Agtmael were inducted Oct. 28 into the TACOM Hall of Fame.
